**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Simpler Settings
- **One place for every key and connection.** The new **Accounts** tab holds your OpenRouter, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI keys plus Google Calendar, Trello and mail. Meeting settings have their own **Meetings** tab.
- **One place for every shortcut.** All global shortcuts, including the Fn key, are set in Settings → General → Keyboard Shortcuts. Each feature tab shows its shortcut in one line with a link there.
- **Model pickers show three picks first.** Every picker leads with Recommended, Fastest and Offline, and the rest sit under "More models". The recommendations prefer models you have a key for. A model without a key stays selectable and says "Needs key".

## Easier start
- **A shorter welcome tour.** Five steps instead of eight, with one early question: run dictation offline on your Mac, or in the cloud? Your answer sets the dictation model.

## Chat
- **Typing `/` lists commands only.** Switch models with `/model`, which opens a searchable list with your current model ticked. Shortcuts like `/grok` or `/mlx` still work when typed in full.

## Fixes
- Opening the key settings no longer asks whether to switch to cloud models when nothing changed.
- The success notice stays up for 3 seconds instead of 1.
- New installs start with Smart Improvement usage logging off.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.49...v8.50
